limitations: Logical unique-key sample and config maps with valid stored sample vectors; physical tree/deque/hash layout and invalid-container panic paths are not implemented.
Sequential floating arithmetic starts at negative zero; finite results and signed-zero bits are compared, NaN payload/sign and FP exception flags are not claimed.
Ordinary nontrapping round-to-nearest-even binary64 environment and valid allocation-sized Vec<f64> lengths are premises.
No captured target execution/emulation, live networking, signing, settlement or chain actions. This does not complete funding or issue3913.
